title: Condom
summary: An external condom is a thin sheath worn on the penis that blocks semen. Used correctly every time, it prevents pregnancy and lowers the risk of most STIs.
steps: Check the expiry date and open the packet carefully (no teeth or scissors)
Put it on an erect penis before any genital contact
Pinch the tip to leave space for semen and roll it down to the base
After ejaculation, hold the base while withdrawing
Use a new condom every time; throw it in the bin, not the toilet
dont: Use oil-based lube with latex condoms
